copy.bannerTitle: We use cookies and similar technologies
copy.bannerDescription: We use cookies to operate this site and, with your consent, for functional, analytics, and communications purposes.
copy.receiptError: Couldn't download the receipt — please try again.
copy.historyError: Couldn't download your consent history — please try again.
copy.gpcNotice: We noticed a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser and limited non-essential data collection accordingly. You can change this anytime below.
copy.presumedActiveNotice: Non-essential cookies are currently active for your region. Turn them off below and save to opt out.
copy.renewalNotice: Your preferences are stored for {days} days on this device. Some browsers, including Safari, may clear this sooner without a visit.
copy.otpPrompt: We've emailed you a 6-digit verification code. Enter it below to confirm this request.
copy.verifyError: Incorrect or expired code — please try again.
copy.ageGateNotice: By choosing Accept or Reject below, you confirm you are 18 years or older per DPDP Act, Section 9.
copy.ageGateBody: Under DPDP Act Section 9, processing personal data of individuals under 18 requires verifiable parental or guardian consent. We have limited data collection to only essential cookies until that consent is provided.
copy.ageGateRestrictionNote: No analytics, marketing, or behavioral tracking data will be collected.
copy.ageGateVerifyIntro: Enter your email address. We'll send a 6-digit code to confirm your age before you continue.
copy.ageGateDobIntro: Enter your date of birth to complete the age check.
copy.declarationRetentionPersistent: Persistent — remains until the site or visitor clears it
copy.declarationRetentionSession: Session — cleared when the browser tab closes
copy.declarationPreConsentWarning: ⚠ Observed firing before consent in our latest scan
copy.declarationEmptyState: No cookies or trackers have been recorded for this site yet.
copy.declarationLoadError: Something went wrong loading the cookie list — please try again.
copy.aboutBoardComplaintLink: Complain to the Data Protection Board

necessary.label: Strictly Necessary
necessary.description: Required for the site to function. Cannot be turned off.
